npcRoster.name: Desmera Veil
npcRoster.publicDescription:
Desmera Veil is a cautious, steel-spined Mycelian organizer who asks one question before trusting anyone: whether they would risk themselves for a person the law has already decided is property, evidence, or waste. As a Mycelian, she is tied to vast underground fungal memory-networks, making her a living archive of routes, disappearances, betrayals, and safe names, with Hathruna’s influence showing through decay, renewal, roots, fungi, and communal survival.
From the Blacktide Reach Guild Desk, Desmera leads the Freeblade Veil as a lantern-mother, coordinating coded signs, safehouses, dead drops, forged identities, and emergency extractions through Marrowynd’s floating and submarine-linked settlements. She is warm only after proof, ruthless when secrecy breaks, and deeply opposed to ichor-fueled institutions that treat sentient people as assets to harvest, reset, sell, or reclaim.

npcRoster.name: Fritsch Gamebell
npcRoster.publicDescription:
Fritsch Gamebell is a warm, nervous Gnome mechanic who survived the Nefaric Veil by making himself too useful to collar, exile, or kill. He keeps the arena games, prize engines, ticket dispensers, training machines, and warded obstacle rooms running with a healer’s patience and a handyman’s instinct, always patching broken people and broken gears with the same tired kindness.

At the Myrkwake Archive, Fritsch manages the arena floor as something between arcade-master, field medic, and reluctant moral compass, making sure the games stay dangerous enough to satisfy raiders but not so lethal that every guest becomes a body. He dislikes ichor-addled cruelty, quietly rigs safety releases into the machines, and has a gentle way of helping frightened fighters feel like they still have a choice, even when the whole Carnival insists they do not.

Hannik Vox is a theatrical, hedonistic, sharp-smiling Gwynis mayor who looks like trouble, talks like a revolutionary, and still somehow means it when they promise the unwanted will have a place to sleep. Years ago, Hannik fled polished civic cruelty, fell into grief and black-market ichor, and deliberately took a dangerous pure dose that changed their body, slowed their aging, and made them impossible to fully separate from the vice-soaked underworld they now protects. From the Vice District Civic Hall, Hannik governs Seawynd Hollow with a loose hand and a hard line: revelry, sex work, ichor use, smuggling, and ugly survival are tolerated, but predators who threaten the district’s outcasts become public examples very quickly.

npcRoster.name: Edren Deegan
npcRoster.publicDescription: Edren Deegan is a human house retainer built out of loyalty, scars, and the kind of patience that looks like menace in a doorway. He serves the Cabot line, manages threats before they reach the parlor, and understands that noble eccentricity becomes criminal negligence when servants are left to clean up the bodies. Edren is blunt, watchful, and more moral than his employers, though he has spent too long obeying people who call containment a family matter.
npcRoster.settlementAncestryTexture: Shadewharf is a Village in Marrowynd, under Representative Democracy, with low danger, Beach and grass with water, Partial forest, Farming terrain, and public routes by Caravan, Train, Ferry, Steamship. Local records favor Altruistic, Lawful, Cooperative, Honorable civic habits; common communities include Human, Halfling — Lightfoot Halfling, Halfling — Stout Halfling, Kender, Kithkin. Eladrin reads through the Half-Elf (choose an Elf Bloodline) entry of the race compendium, within Humans, Near-Humans, and Mixed Heritage, marked by Nebyrr. The local form is read through Half-Elf — Eladrin. Half-elves are dual-natured beings born of human and elven lineage, often balancing ambition with longevity. They tend to struggle with identity but excel at diplomacy, adaptability, and bridging cultures. Table cues: +2 Charisma, +1 to Two Other Ability Scores, Darkvision, Fey Ancestry; starting tendency Neutral - Lawful - Cooperative - Neutral.
publicRumors: Edren has buried more Cabot secrets than the family mausoleum.
He pays informants from his own purse when the household refuses to admit danger is coming.

areaModel.method: Earth-sized spherical Voronoi province territory model
areaModel.reason: The province JSON files contain locked province center latitude/longitude coordinates, but no hand-drawn province border polygons. A low-pressure sea storm arriving with a strong moon tide.
A sudden retreat of water before trench-fed surge returns.
A black-green wall of rain that crosses whole coasts.
Short, sharp squalls that arrive in pairs or trios every few days.
Moonlit fog so bright it makes ships look closer than they are.
A towering thunderhead that forms over heated highlands.
Greenish swamp fog carrying spores, firefly light, and bad directions.
A suffocating, windless heat that freezes sails and tempers alike.
A rotating storm whose calm center is ringed by clear, staring sky.
Low rolling thunder that repeats long before the rain reaches a settlement.
Warm gas-fog from marsh canals and low cave mouths.
A fine crosswind rain that seems to fall sideways from many directions.
Shimmering heat that turns distance into false water and false stone.
Three winds meeting over cliffs, reefs, or a canyon mouth.
A steep, dark swell pushed by far-off pressure changes.
Warm rain that wakes rot, swollen roots, and hungry fungus.
A sudden evening wind that turns forest travel loud and blind.
A hooked dust plume ahead of dryline storms.
Highland lightning that walks along exposed ridges.
Rain-soaked clay roads that swallow carts and boots.
A season when road puddles hide sinkholes, leeches, and false bottoms.
A dry graveyard wind that carries dust, spores, and old sickness.
A clean mountain lift used by skyships and great birds.
A fast pull beneath reef water during strong tide shifts.
Thin cold rain that whistles through ruins and empty rigging.
One storm-fed river splits into several dangerous surges.
A spiraling river or sea current that turns boats sideways.
A soft glowing insect and spore bloom after warm moon rain.

majorWaters.Name: Moonwake Ocean
